name: Frequency Domain Volume Rendering with Sinc Resampling
aliases: Frequency Domain Volume Rendering with Shear-Warp Factorization
definition: A volume rendering algorithm that performs resampling using the ideal interpolation filter (sinc) to achieve the best theoretical quality, exploiting signal processing ideas such as the shifting theorem, the packing theorem, and the derivative theorem.
summary: Frequency Domain Volume Rendering with Sinc Resampling is a direct volume ray casting technique that performs resampling in the frequency domain using Fourier transforms to avoid blurring artifacts associated with spatial domain interpolation.
